records.noteEn: Relevant working experience is PREFERRED. Excellent new graduates may also be considered. English thresholds apply to selected English-only electives, not universally to this Putonghua-medium degree. Current page confirms one-year full-time. Chinese language proficiency/equivalence and any additional application-system requests require university assessment; no personal eligibility, entry GPA or automatic waiver is inferred.

At least TWO years of professional and/or managerial experience is PREFERRED, not a mandatory work-year minimum. Current page confirms one-year full-time. Chinese language proficiency/equivalence and any additional application-system requests require university assessment; no personal eligibility, entry GPA or automatic waiver is inferred.

Education, social sciences, humanities, management or engineering backgrounds and relevant work are PREFERRED, not mandatory exclusive major/work rules. Shortlisted interview may apply. Current page confirms one-year full-time. Chinese language proficiency/equivalence and any additional application-system requests require university assessment; no personal eligibility, entry GPA or automatic waiver is inferred.

The old official page explicitly documents revamping as Digital Human Resource Management FROM 2027/28 and links the new page. Same degree code A1M129 and existing ID; former Organisational Marketing title belongs to 2026/27. Welcomes all fields with relevant interest; interview may apply. Current page confirms one-year full-time. Chinese language proficiency/equivalence and any additional application-system requests require university assessment; no personal eligibility, entry GPA or automatic waiver is inferred.

Recognised bachelor/equivalent; shortlisted interview may apply. Curriculum topics do not establish a mandatory business major. Current page confirms one-year full-time. Chinese language proficiency/equivalence and any additional application-system requests require university assessment; no personal eligibility, entry GPA or automatic waiver is inferred.

Recognised bachelor/equivalent. Mainland-university degree holders must provide degree/graduation certificates, corresponding CHSI reports valid SIX MONTHS, and final transcript. This is conditional on qualification location, not nationality. A historical Shanghai field trip in March 2026 is not proof of a compulsory current overseas delivery period. Current page confirms one-year full-time. Chinese language proficiency/equivalence and any additional application-system requests require university assessment; no personal eligibility, entry GPA or automatic waiver is inferred.

Recognised bachelor/equivalent. Headline lists one-year FT, but curriculum prose also mentions two-year PT. PT availability/current fee basis requires confirmation; only headline-confirmed FT is represented. English evidence applies to the specified English-only elective choice, not all applicants. Current page confirms one-year full-time. Chinese language proficiency/equivalence and any additional application-system requests require university assessment; no personal eligibility, entry GPA or automatic waiver is inferred.

Recognised bachelor/equivalent; admission interview may apply. Local and non-local tuition differ and require explicit category selection. Current page confirms one-year full-time. Chinese language proficiency/equivalence and any additional application-system requests require university assessment; no personal eligibility, entry GPA or automatic waiver is inferred.

Engineering, science, computing, AI and robotics degrees are PREFERRED, not an exclusive hard major list. Shortlisted interview may apply. Current page confirms one-year full-time. Chinese language proficiency/equivalence and any additional application-system requests require university assessment; no personal eligibility, entry GPA or automatic waiver is inferred.

Recognised bachelor/equivalent. Programme career suggestions do not automatically confer a psychologist, counsellor or teacher licence. Current page confirms one-year full-time. Chinese language proficiency/equivalence and any additional application-system requests require university assessment; no personal eligibility, entry GPA or automatic waiver is inferred.

Relevant experience in art creation, museums, auction houses or galleries is PREFERRED; excellent new graduates may also be considered. Shortlisted interview may apply. No universal work-year or art-degree minimum inferred. Current page confirms one-year full-time. Chinese language proficiency/equivalence and any additional application-system requests require university assessment; no personal eligibility, entry GPA or automatic waiver is inferred.

Relevant working experience is PREFERRED; excellent new graduates may also be considered. No universal health-degree or work-year minimum inferred. Current page confirms one-year full-time. Chinese language proficiency/equivalence and any additional application-system requests require university assessment; no personal eligibility, entry GPA or automatic waiver is inferred.

Applicants MUST submit a 500-WORD GBA career vision statement IN CHINESE. Preserve the English-page unit as WORDS rather than silently converting it to characters. Shortlisted interview may apply. Target audiences are not an exclusive major requirement. Current page confirms one-year full-time. Chinese language proficiency/equivalence and any additional application-system requests require university assessment; no personal eligibility, entry GPA or automatic waiver is inferred.

Recognised bachelor/equivalent; shortlisted interview may apply. English instruction. Tuition excludes optional field-trip expenses; it is not an all-in living/travel budget. Current page confirms one-year full-time. Chinese language proficiency/equivalence and any additional application-system requests require university assessment; no personal eligibility, entry GPA or automatic waiver is inferred.

Recognised bachelor/equivalent; shortlisted interview may apply. Putonghua instruction; do not copy the English Master of Global Management threshold into this separate degree. Tuition excludes field-trip costs. Current page confirms one-year full-time. Chinese language proficiency/equivalence and any additional application-system requests require university assessment; no personal eligibility, entry GPA or automatic waiver is inferred.
